schema.description: Story relay vault (VaultBaseV3 / factory v2.3). Factory owns the vault beacon; upgrades are Guardian-only. Until openLaunch, only launchOpener may create a vault; afterwards anyone may launch through VaultPortal. Quote may be native BNB or any ERC20. Generate fee is always BNB. Character CID plus the opening sentence are required. Quote tax first pays the Flap template fee to the immutable factory devAddress (6% if tax rate <= 1%, else 6/rate). Remaining quote tax stays unallocated. A successful writer takes 1%-5% of that pot, snapshotted at submit. Step length is 2/3/4/5 minutes by act. This vault does not issue rescue tokens.

fields.name: characterCid
fields.description: IPFS CID for the story character reference (video type 4).

fields.name: openingPrompt
fields.description: Opening sentence filmed on the first clip if the writer leaves prompt empty.
